require 'openssl'
require 'async'
require 'async/barrier'
require 'json'

module CryptoService
  class KeyDerivation
    ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS = %w[sha256 sha384 sha512].freeze
    DEFAULT_ITERATIONS = 100_000

    def initialize(config = {})
      @config = config
      @key_cache = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def derive_key(params)
      algorithm = sanitize_algorithm(params[:algorithm])
      salt = params[:salt] || OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(32)
      iterations = validate_iterations(params[:iterations])
      key_length = params[:key_length] || 32

      cache_key = compute_cache_key(params[:password], algorithm, salt, iterations, key_length)
      
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return @key_cache[cache_key] if @key_cache.key?(cache_key)
      end

      derived = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(
        params[:password].to_s,
        salt: salt,
        iterations: iterations,
        length: key_length,
        hash: algorithm
      )

      @mutex.synchronize do
        @key_cache[cache_key] = derived
      end

      derived
    end

    private

    def sanitize_algorithm(algo)
      algo = algo.to_s.downcase.strip
      unless ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS.include?(algo)
        raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported algorithm: #{algo}"
      end
      algo
    end

    def validate_iterations(iter)
      iter = iter.to_i
      iter >= 10_000 ? iter : DEFAULT_ITERATIONS
    end

    def compute_cache_key(password, algorithm, salt, iterations, key_length)
      # Include a hash of the password so distinct passwords never collide
      # in the cache and return the wrong derived key.
      password_digest = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(password.to_s)
      OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(
        "#{password_digest}:#{algorithm}:#{salt}:#{iterations}:#{key_length}"
      )
    end
  end

  class AsyncCryptoProcessor
    def initialize(key_derivation: KeyDerivation.new)
      @kdf = key_derivation
      @task_registry = {}
      @expression_evaluator = ExpressionEvaluator.new
    end

    def process_batch(requests)
      Async do |task|
        barrier = Async::Barrier.new
        results = []

        requests.each_with_index do |req, idx|
          barrier.async do
            result = process_single(req, task)
            results[idx] = result
          end
        end

        barrier.wait
        results
      end.wait
    end

    def process_single(request, parent_task = nil)
      operation = request[:operation]
      params = request[:params] || {}

      case operation
      when 'derive'
        @kdf.derive_key(params)
      when 'encrypt'
        perform_encryption(params)
      when 'transform'
        apply_transform(params)
      else
        { error: "Unknown operation: #{operation}" }
      end
    end

    private

    def perform_encryption(params)
      # Force a 32-byte key for AES-256 so an attacker-controlled
      # key_length cannot weaken the derived key size.
      key = @kdf.derive_key(params.merge(key_length: 32))
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES256.new(:GCM)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      
      cipher.auth_data = params[:aad].to_s
      ciphertext = cipher.update(params[:plaintext].to_s) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag

      { iv: iv, ciphertext: ciphertext, tag: tag }
    end

    def apply_transform(params)
      expression = params[:expression]
      context = build_transform_context(params)
      @expression_evaluator.evaluate(expression, context)
    end

    def build_transform_context(params)
      {
        input: params[:input],
        encoding: params[:encoding] || 'hex',
        length: params[:length] || 32
      }
    end
  end

  class ExpressionEvaluator
    SAFE_METHODS = %w[encode decode slice length reverse upcase downcase hex].freeze
    OPERATOR_PATTERN = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9_.\[\]()\s]+\z/

    def evaluate(expression, context)
      return nil if expression.nil? || expression.empty?
      
      unless valid_expression?(expression)
        raise SecurityError, "Invalid expression: contains disallowed characters"
      end

      resolved = resolve_variables(expression, context)
      execute_expression(resolved, context)
    end

    private

    def valid_expression?(expr)
      expr.match?(OPERATOR_PATTERN)
    end

    def resolve_variables(expression, context)
      expression.gsub(/\b(input|encoding|length)\b/) do |match|
        value = context[match.to_sym]
        value.is_a?(String) ? value : value.to_s
      end
    end

    def execute_expression(resolved, context)
      parts = resolved.split('.')
      base = parts.shift
      
      result = base
      parts.each do |method_call|
        method_name = method_call.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z_]/, '')
        if SAFE_METHODS.include?(method_name)
          result = result.send(method_name) rescue result
        end
      end
      result
    end
  end

  class TransformPipeline
    def initialize(processor)
      @processor = processor
      @pipeline_steps = []
    end

    def add_step(step_config)
      @pipeline_steps << step_config
      self
    end

    def execute(initial_input)
      current = initial_input
      
      @pipeline_steps.each do |step|
        params = step[:params].merge(input: current)
        template = step[:template]
        
        if template
          params = interpolate_template(template, params)
        end
        
        current = @processor.process_single(
          { operation: step[:operation], params: params }
        )
      end
      
      current
    end

    private

    def interpolate_template(template, params)
      result = params.dup
      template.each do |key, tmpl_value|
        if tmpl_value.is_a?(String) && tmpl_value.include?('#{')
          result[key] = safe_interpolate(tmpl_value, params)
        else
          result[key] = tmpl_value
        end
      end
      result
    end

    def safe_interpolate(template_str, params)
      output = template_str.dup
      output.gsub(/\#\{(\w+)\}/) do |_match|
        var_name = $1.to_sym
        if params.key?(var_name)
          params[var_name].to_s
        else
          ''
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
